name: utility audits

product.purpose: Prepare a customer-reviewed estimate and unsigned Indiana restaurant electricity exemption application data.
product.launch_state: Indiana (recommended; owner confirmation required before launch)
product.scope: Indiana restaurant electricity sales tax and customer-entered flat-rate scenarios. No utility data service or automated tariff lookup is used.
product.billing: Potential share of refunds and first-year savings; owner must approve the model and legal basis before customer launch.

your_steps.title: Confirm Indiana as the launch state
your_steps.when: Before offering this venture to customers
your_steps.detail: Indiana is recommended because its restaurant electricity rule uses a 75% prepared-food receipts threshold and a fixed 50% electricity sales-tax election through one meter. Confirm Indiana before any customer work or filing support.

your_steps.title: Provide seller-level and meter records
your_steps.detail: Enter DOR-formula annual prepared-food and total-food sales for all of the seller's Indiana establishments, confirm the scope, then enter 12 consecutive months of selected-meter form figures and electricity bills. Optional rate scenarios need customer-supplied published flat rates and links. Do not upload tax IDs or other sensitive data into the sample fixture.

your_steps.title: Review, sign, and submit the application
your_steps.detail: Review every field against the official ST-200R, complete missing fields, attach bills, sign as the customer, and submit it to Indiana DOR. Glacier never signs or submits it. The customer sends the resulting ST-109R to the utility after DOR approval.

launch_gates: Owner confirms Indiana as the launch state.
Owner approves any model that charges a share of refunds or savings.
Customer reviews, signs, and submits all state applications and sends any issued certificate to the utility.
